title: Structural insights into the recognition of the A/T-rich motif in target gene promoters by the LMX1a homeobox domain.
authors: Lin, Liqing; Deng, Jie; Peng, Junhui; Cui, Jing; Wang, Lei; Zhang, Min; Gao, Jia; Li, Fudong; Shi, Yunyu; Lv, Mengqi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构与MD模拟解析LMX1a同源异型域对A/T富集启动子DNA的特异性识别机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作界面与动态机理，方法含结构建模与分子动力学，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: LIM homeodomain transcription factor 1-alpha (LMX1a) is a neuronal lineage-specific transcription activator that plays an essential role during the development of midbrain dopaminergic (mDA) neurons. LMX1a induces the expression of multiple key genes, which ultimately determine the morphology, physiology, and functional identity of mDA neurons. This function of LMX1a is dependent on its homeobox domain. Here, we determined the structures of the LMX1a homeobox domain in complex with the promoter sequences of the Wnt family member 1 (WNT1) or paired like homeodomain 3 (Pitx3) gene, respectively. The complex structures revealed that the LMX1a homeobox domain employed its alpha3 helix and an N-terminal loop to achieve specific target recognition. The N-terminal loop (loop1) interacted with the minor groove of the double-stranded DNA (dsDNA), whereas the third alpha-helix (alpha3) was tightly packed into the major groove of the dsDNA. Structure-based mutations in the alpha3 helix of the homeobox domain significantly reduced the binding affinity of LMX1a to dsDNA. Moreover, we identified a nonsyndromic hearing loss (NSHL)-related mutation, R199, which yielded a more flexible loop and disturbed the recognition in the minor groove of dsDNA, consistent with the molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Furthermore, overexpression of Lmx1a promoted the differentiation of SH-SY5Y cells and upregulated the transcription of WNT1 and PITX3 genes. Hence, our work provides a detailed elucidation of the specific recognition between the LMX1a homeobox domain and its specific dsDNA targets, which represents valuable information for future investigations of the functional pathways that are controlled by LMX1a during mDA neuron development.
abstract_zh: LIM同源结构域转录因子1-α（LMX1a）是一种神经元谱系特异性转录激活因子，在中脑多巴胺能（mDA）神经元的发育过程中发挥关键作用。LMX1a诱导多个关键基因的表达，这些基因最终决定mDA神经元的形态、生理和功能特性。LMX1a的这一功能依赖于其同源结构域（homeobox domain）。在此，我们分别确定了LMX1a同源结构域与Wnt家族成员1（WNT1）或配对样同源结构域3（Pitx3）基因启动子序列复合物的结构。复合物结构揭示，LMX1a同源结构域利用其α3螺旋和一个N端环来实现特异性靶标识别。N端环（loop1）与双链DNA（dsDNA）的小沟相互作用，而第三个α螺旋（α3）则紧密嵌入dsDNA的大沟中。基于结构的α3螺旋突变显著降低了LMX1a与dsDNA的结合亲和力。此外，我们识别出一个非综合征性听力损失（NSHL）相关突变R199，该突变导致环更灵活并干扰dsDNA小沟中的识别，这与分子动力学（MD）模拟结果一致。进一步研究表明，Lmx1a的过表达促进了SH-SY5Y细胞的分化，并上调了WNT1和PITX3基因的转录。因此，我们的工作详细阐明了LMX1a同源结构域与其特定dsDNA靶标之间的特异性识别，这为未来研究LMX1a在mDA神经元发育过程中控制的功能通路提供了宝贵信息。
